name: Social Immersion
description: Students will visit an identified social immersion site to observe and study community needs in context. They will document their findings through photography, videography, sketches, and doodles, capturing both tangible and intangible aspects of daily life. Special attention will be given to identifying ergonomic, usability, utilitarian, cultural, psychological, or physiological challenges in the tasks people perform within the social environment. Through brainstorming and design thinking exercises, students will explore potential solutions that address these issues. The outcomes will be consolidated and communicated through a structured report, presentation, or short video highlighting the identified needs and proposed interventions.
